router_body:
name: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: full job set selected
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: echo 'SELECTED plan-test linux macos perf tier'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
      - name: local gate wiring proof
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: python3 -I ci/local-gate-test.py
      - name: local evidence gate
        if: ${{ !(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix')) }}
        run: echo 'Local gauntlet evidence is the gate; request ci or full-matrix for CI.'

ci.yml.plan-test:
# tier: pr
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'plan-test')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - run: python3 -I .lair/ci/tiers-test.py
      - run: python3 -I .lair/ci/memgate-test.py
ci.yml.linux:
# tier: pr
    name: linux x86-64 (fmt, tests, builds, goldens, pty rows in the container)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'linux')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-linux-${{ hashFiles('.lair/wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: .lair/tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: the Linux leg, in the container
        env:
          LAIR_ENGINE: docker
        run: .lair/tools/in-container .lair/tools/check-linux
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: linux-evidence
          path: |
            target/goldens
            target/pty
            target/test.log
ci.yml.macos:
name: macOS arm64 (build, goldens, pty rows)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'macos')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-macos-${{ hashFiles('.lair/wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: .lair/tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: wolf fmt --check
        run: .lair/tools/check-fmt
      - name: the unit tests
        run: .lair/tools/test
      # RULES section 4's memory gate is nomad's (the maintainer's Mac); the
      # runner's free-memory figure means nothing for it (lair's lib-mem.sh).
      - name: build, both tiers
        env:
          LAIR_MEMORY_GATE: '0'
        run: .lair/tools/build --all
      - name: the goldens, both tiers
        env:
          LAIR_MEMORY_GATE: '0'
        run: .lair/tools/goldens
      - name: the pty rows
        env:
          LAIR_MEMORY_GATE: '0'
        run: python3 -I .lair/tools/pty --bin target/release/pack
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: macos-evidence
          path: |
            target/goldens
            target/pty
ci.yml.perf:
name: perf gate (render and idle, release)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'perf')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-linux-${{ hashFiles('.lair/wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: .lair/tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: the perf gate, in the container
        env:
          LAIR_ENGINE: docker
          LAIR_PERF_SLACK: '3'
        run: .lair/tools/in-container .lair/tools/perf
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: perf-evidence
          path: target/perf
ci.yml.tier:
name: tier ${{ needs.plan.outputs.tier || 'unplanned' }}
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    needs:
      - plan
      - plan-test
      - linux
      - macos
      - perf
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python3 .lair/ci/tiers.py verdict
ci.yml.nightly-red:
name: nightly red, an issue
    needs: tier
    if: ${{ failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: .lair/ci/nightly-red.sh
